chunks: What Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā narrated from Muḥammad ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Khallād al-Sindī, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, concerning:

About a man who slaughtered a pigeon from the pigeons of the Haram, he said: upon him is the fidyah. I said: Then may he eat it? He said: No. I said: Then may he discard it? He said: If he discards it, then another fidyah is upon him. I said: Then what should he do with it? He said: He should bury it.
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on slaughtering and disposing of a pigeon from the Haram?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding one who slaughters a pigeon from the pigeons of the Haram while in a prohibited state related to hajj. It states that fidyah is due, that the meat may not be eaten, and that it should not be cast away; rather, it should be buried.
